title: File:Electric atmosphere - Streetcorner with overhead power lines under a stormy sky in Vang Vieng, Laos.jpg
desc: Electric atmosphere - Streetcorner, exterior facade of the building BaanNa Cafe with electricity pylon and overhead power lines, under a stormy sky and extremely dark clouds, during the monsoon, in Vang Vieng, Vientiane Province, Laos. Tone-mapped HDR picture.

title: File:Lightning Bolt Arlington, Texas Apr 24 2011.JPG
desc: A lightning bolt as seen from about 500 ft. away, a mile north of Pantego, Texas. The lightning was associated with a severe storm that had produced golfball sized hail four miles to the south of this photo. The lightning had struck a tree several blocks eastward.

title: File:2020augderecho-WMT-tower-Marion-IA.jpg
desc: Collapsed radio tower bent and toppled to the ground by extreme winds from the w:August 2020 Midwest derecho. Tower of local radio station w:WMT (AM) north of w:Marion, Iowa. NWS estimates winds around 130 mph (210 km/h; 58 m/s) caused this particular damage.

title: File:Aurora borealis over Brastad on a foggy night 1.jpg
desc: Multicolored aurora borealis, northern lights on a foggy night with clouds over Brastad, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden. Photo taken from Tuntorp.
